what_it_proves: The trace reached the native pre-SCTLR hook after validating the MAIR/TCR/TTBR1/VBAR and existing page-table descriptors.
A single valid L2 2MiB Device framebuffer alias was installed in the TTBR1 table.
Native SCTLR_EL1 write and ISB completed; CPU executed the post-ISB hook and successfully wrote text through the high TTBR1 virtual framebuffer alias.
CPU executed past the original CMP/B.NE guard to the 0xFFFFFFF0073F2370 hook.
what_it_does_not_prove: Native CPACR_EL1 and TPIDR_EL1 writes completed after the last hook.
Return from set_mmu_ttb to higher level XNU bootstrapping.
Memory allocator, exceptions, scheduler, IOKit, rootfs or userland initialization.
note: Visible UniXNU menu background is stale pre-existing framebuffer contents; does not mean control returned to UEFI.
safety: Future tests: temporary fastboot boot only; never fastboot flash.
